tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Flagship. One public page as Markdown ($0.003 x402, synchronous, charged only on success). Pay with X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, or a prepaid API key. Part of the AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: fetch_batch
tools.description: Up to 5 pages as Markdown in one call ($0.008 per batch, synchronous, charged only if at least one page succeeds). AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: Base wallet snapshot ($0.003, synchronous, charged only on success). Read-only. AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: erc20_balance
tools.description: Read-only Base ERC-20 balance ($0.003). AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: chain_tx
tools.description: Read-only Base transaction lookup ($0.003). Never sends a transaction.

tools.name: chain_gas
tools.description: Read-only Base gas price ($0.002).

tools.name: chain_contract
tools.description: Read-only contract bytecode check on Base ($0.004). Does not execute code.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Liveness ping ($0.002) returning ok, ts, payer, and price.

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Email syntax, MX, disposable and role flags, SPF and DMARC ($0.002). No SMTP probe. The address is not stored.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Queue a cited web lookup ($0.01). Returns 202 with job_id. Typical ETA 10–20 minutes; poll get_job.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Deep task, 10–20 min. Claim/company/URL verification ($0.08). Returns 202 with job_id; poll get_job.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Deep task, 10–20 min. Short cited brief ($0.30). Returns 202 with job_id; poll get_job.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a previously queued AutoPay job by id until status is done.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Document extraction: PDF/image (url or file_base64, max 10 MB) -> typed fields, line items, OCR text, document type ($0.025 per page, max 5 pages billed; synchronous, charged only on success). Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or a prepaid API key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check, geo_check · Private data: fetch, wallet, extract, security_scan, security_scan_headers, security_scan_tls, security_scan_dns, security_scan_exposure, security_scan_full, geo_check · Public sink: email_check · Destructive: chain_contract.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check, geo_check · Private data: fetch, wallet, extract, security_scan, security_scan_headers, security_scan_tls, security_scan_dns, security_scan_exposure, security_scan_full, geo_check · Public sink: email_check · Destructive: chain_contract

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
